gloss: to come to a dead end; to reach an impasse

definitions.gloss: to come to a dead end; to reach a dead end
definitions.explanation: To reach a point where a road, path, or passage ends and one cannot go further.

definitions.gloss: to reach an impasse; to be stuck
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to reach a point where no further progress can be made in a plan, investigation, or negotiation.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go) and ⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ (to stop). The related noun ⟦{行|い}き{止|ど}まり→行き止まり：08167_ikidomari⟧ (dead end) is extremely common and appears on road signs throughout Japan.

USAGE:
- Intransitive verb — the subject is the road, path, investigation, etc.
- The noun form ⟦{行|い}き{止|ど}まり→行き止まり：08167_ikidomari⟧ is more common in everyday use than the verb
- Often seen on road signs: ⟦{行|い}き{止|ど}まり→行き止まり：08167_ikidomari⟧ (Dead End)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{止|ど}まる: the road comes to a dead end
- ⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{止|ど}まる: the investigation hits a dead end
- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{止|ど}まる: negotiations stall
- ⟦{行|い}き{止|ど}まり→行き止まり：08167_ikidomari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: a dead-end road

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる→行き詰まる：09346_ikizumaru⟧: to be stuck, to reach a deadlock — emphasizes being completely blocked with no way forward; stronger and more commonly figurative
- ⟦{行|い}き{止|ど}まり→行き止まり：08167_ikidomari⟧: dead end (noun) — the noun form, used on signs and in directions
- ⟦{立|た}ち{往生|おうじょう}→立ち往生：17522_tachioujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be stranded, to be stuck — unable to move (often vehicles or people)
